summary: Universe Pharmaceuticals Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of its acquisition of Best Praise International Limited (the Target), a company holding five China patents for pharmaceutical compounds in age-related, neurodegenerative, cognitive, and cardiovascular areas. The acquisition, pursuant to a Share Purchase Agreement dated June 17, 2026, closed on June 30, 2026. As consideration, the company issued 4,376,552 restricted Class A ordinary shares to the sellers. No cash amount, premium, or valuation was disclosed. Post-issue share counts are 5,008,313 Class A and 16,077 Class B. What to watch: Nasdaq compliance and resale registration rights.
